comparison.objective: Set a lintel across two free-standing posts without moving them.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually place and balance a long member while avoiding lateral contact with unstable supports.
comparison.success_condition: Lintel rests across both posts and posts remain unmoved; numeric tolerances are unavailable.
comparison.reason: This tests large-part placement and disturbance avoidance, not recessed tool alignment, controlled hammer impact, fracture, or fragment capture.
